body:
This mod adds boxes with loot inside it. devices, tools, armor and items! there is a suit, tablet, boxes, workbench, and many others! (Note: The icon may be changed later but for now its going to look like this)
###                                      **Pictures🖼️**

![Items in item frames
](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b43b0d653bf5ff5a6c920637cf8d7ca97618297.png)

### **🔨What the items do?**

**The armor (Suit)**
gives a total of 36 damage value a bit better than netherite

**The tablet**
Does nothing as of right now

**The boxes**
Give you items of what you got
